Our emcees are the lively thread connecting the sessions, speakers, and shared energy of WordCamp Asia 2026. With enthusiasm, professionalism, and a touch of personality, they help set the tone on stage and ensure the program flows smoothly from start to finish.

As your guides throughout the event, our emcees will introduce speakers, highlight important announcements, and keep the audience engaged between sessions. Their presence helps maintain the rhythm of the event while creating a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere for everyone attending.

Get to know the voices behind the microphone and join us in celebrating the people who help bring the WordCamp Asia 2026 stage to life!

Moses Cursor is an ICT Manager, WordPress Community Leader, and open-source advocate based in Uganda. ### Nupur Deshmukh

#### **India**

Nupur Deshmukh is a dynamic Computer Applications student with a deep passion for technology, innovation, and communication. A winner of multiple national-level hackathons and Model United Nations conferences, she is recognized for her analytical mindset, leadership skills, and confident public speaking. As an emcee at WordCamp Asia 2026, she brings structure, enthusiasm, and vibrant stage energy that celebrates innovation, collaboration, and community spirit.

### Indira Biswas

#### **India**

Indira Biswas is a WordPress Quality Assurance Engineer and open-source contributor from India who believes that technology should create opportunities, not barriers. She contributes across Core, Photos, Polyglots, and Test teams, with a strong focus on quality, accessibility, and making WordPress more inclusive for non-English users through her Hindi translation work.\
\
An active community voice, Indira has spoken and led workshops at WordCamps and meetups across India, helping newcomers discover that open source is not just about code, it’s about belonging. Coming from a small town, she has experienced firsthand how WordPress can unlock global possibilities without leaving home. This journey fuels her passion for uplifting women and underrepresented contributors, and for building a more welcoming, human-centered open-source ecosystem.

### Mina Tamang

#### **Nepal**

Mina is a digital marketer with over eight years of experience, currently leading the Marketing team at Codewing. She serves as Immediate Past President of the Founders Toastmasters Club, where she has spent years working on the craft of communication and leadership. Not just as concepts, but as practical skills she continues to build.\
\
Since 2023, Mina has been an active part of the WordPress community. First as an attendee, then stepping into roles as a speaker and organizer. It’s a community she has grown alongside, and one she continues to invest in through collaboration and contribution.

### Patrick Lumumba

#### **Kenya**

Patrick is a passionate web developer, QA Engineer at WPMU DEV, and an avid WordPress contributor. With a deep love for sharing knowledge, he regularly writes and speaks about WordPress, blogging, and web design.\
\
Patrick’s expertise in quality assurance and testing has made him a key figure in the WordPress community, most notably as the Test Lead for WordPress 6.5, a major core release.\
\
Beyond his technical contributions, Patrick is an active community builder. He co-organizes the WordPress Nairobi Meetup and mentors aspiring contributors through the WordPress Mentorship Program.

### Eurika K.C

#### **Nepal**

Eurika KC is a passionate web developer, technology enthusiast, and dynamic event host based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Blending her love for technology with the art of communication, she brings both technical insight and vibrant stage presence to every platform she steps onto. Over the years, Eurika has actively hosted community events, youth programs, and local gatherings, becoming a familiar and trusted voice in both tech and social circles. Her ability to guide conversations smoothly, energize audiences, and create a welcoming atmosphere allows speakers and attendees alike to feel comfortable, valued, and heard. Through collaborations with media platforms and digital creators, she has further strengthened her storytelling, communication, and audience engagement skills.\
\
Beyond her professional journey, Eurika is deeply committed to personal growth, public speaking, and meaningful human connection. She believes technology becomes truly powerful when paired with authentic stories, shared knowledge, and inclusive conversations. Her love for travel, creativity, and exploration fuels her curiosity and adds warmth and relatability to her presence on stage.\
\
As an Emcee for WordCamp Asia 2026, Eurika aims to create an inclusive, engaging, and memorable experience celebrating diversity, spotlighting talent, and ensuring every attendee feels seen, inspired, and connected.

### Namrata Baile

#### India

Namrata Baile is an analytically driven business professional with a strong background in business analysis, technology, and stakeholder management. She holds an MBA in Business Analytics and brings over four years of overall experience, including hands-on work in both business analysis and full-stack development. Currently associated with miniOrange, Namrata works closely with global customers to understand business requirements, deliver technical solutions, and drive product adoption.\
\
Her expertise lies in bridging the gap between business needs and technical implementation, leveraging data insights to support informed decision-making and process improvements. Known for her strong communication skills and problem-solving mindset, she effectively collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver value-driven outcomes.\
\
A gold medalist during her MBA, Namrata is passionate about continuous learning, analytics, and using technology to create meaningful business impact.

### Harsh Bhatt

#### India

Meet Harsh Bhatt, a visionary business professional with over 10 years of experience driving growth and building meaningful relationships. He thrives on creating connections rooted in trust, collaboration, and long-term business partnerships.\
\
Outside of work, Harsh enjoys exploring new places, meeting new people, and spending quality time with his family. He is a proud father of two wonderful children and deeply values the balance between professional ambition and family life.\
\
Harsh is also an active member of the Global WordPress community, always eager to learn, share knowledge, and contribute wherever he can. And yes—he absolutely loves watching and playing cricket.
